slices.label: ioctl command normalization, process owner and dispatch table
callback registration stores the same handle context before queue registration
receive callback slot binding and shared FIFO removal
callback FIFO append and all-slot wake scan

userspace_contract: stage232 libosal_uipc shared fd ioctl8000000d + 32B reply containing callback/arg/message/index

queue_algorithm.append: tail of context+0x38 singly-linked pending callback list
queue_algorithm.receive: remove head of same context+0x38 under spin lock
queue_algorithm.wake: scan all four sleep slots and wake each populated task

limits: Static fixed module bytes, not the currently loaded module or runtime state.
User receiver count comes from unmeasured target configuration; four supported slots do not mean four active threads.
No full scheduler/kernel/IPC/driver execution; synthetic interleavings are conditional possibilities.
Other routes outside the pinned branch are not exhaustively excluded.
implication: If multiple receivers share this handle, different slots can remove successive callbacks; same service queue is insufficient to establish231same-live-creator-thread eligibility.
